description_en: Retrieves a URL to upload a user file
description_zh: 获取用户文件上传URL，使用该URL进行文件上传
kebab_example: aliyun vs describe-comfy-user-data-upload-url --file-name myfile --file-size-bytes 1024 --file-md5 54d6911ba6d59dbe68990835a409f18c --content-type application/jpeg --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeComfyUserDataUploadUrl

parameters.help_en: The name of the file to upload. The filename can be a single file, such as \`1.jpg\`, or include a path, such as \`directory1/1.jpg\`
parameters.help_zh: 上传文件的文件名。文件名格式可以上传单文件名（例如：1.jpg）或路径格式（例如：dircectory1/1.jpg）
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The actual size of the file in bytes. This value must be the exact size of the file. The file size is verified when you use the upload URL
parameters.help_zh: 待上传文件的实际Byte大小。该值必须为待上传文件的实际Byte大小，在通过上传URL时会对文件大小进行校验
parameters.name: file_size_bytes

parameters.help_en: The MD5 hash of the file to be uploaded. This value must be the file's actual MD5 hash. The file size is also verified during the upload
parameters.help_zh: 待上传文件的MD5值。该值必须为待上传文件的实际MD5值，在通过上传URL时会对文件大小进行校验
parameters.name: file_md5

parameters.help_en: The content type of the file
parameters.name: content_type
